DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR UNITED STATES INDIAN SERVICE INDIAN INDUSTRIAL SCHOOL CARLISLE, PA. January 21, 1907 John Leslie Shelton, Wash. Dear friend;- Please oblige by answering the questions below accurately and promptly and return this paper to me in the enclosed envelope, which requires no postage. Are you married and if so to whom? Not Married. What is your Post Office address? Olympia, Wash. What is your occupation? Marine Engineer At present I am Chief Engineer on Steamer City of Shelton, running out of Olympia, Wash. Have you been in the Indian Service, in what positions and how long in each? Never been in the Indian Service. Have you lived in the East any part of the time since your graduation and if so, where, how long and what positions did you fill? Never lived in the East after graduation. Your friend March 5, 1907 W.A. Mercer Major 11th Cavalry, Superintendent. CARLISLE INDIAN INDUSTRIAL SCHOOL. DESCRIPTIVE AND HISTORICAL RECORD OF STUDENT. NUMBER 1376 ENGLISH NAME John Leslie INDIAN NAME Jim Leslie HOME ADDRESS Puyallup NATION BLOOD 3/4 AGE 21 HEIGHT 5-5 1/2 WEIGHT 165 FORCED INSP. 39 1/2 FORCED EXPR. 35 SEX. M PARENTS LIVING OR DEAD FATHER Dead MOTHER Living ARRIVED AT SCHOOL Aug. 27, 1892 FOR WHAT PERIOD 5 years DATE DISCHARGED Mar. 5, 1896 CAUSE OF DISCHARGE Graduate TO COUNTRY Jul. 18, 93 PATRONS NAME AND ADDRESS A. Rogers Midvale Pa. FROM COUNTRY Apr. 8, 93 Months in school before Carlisle. Grade entered at Carlisle. Grade at date of Discharge. Trade or Industry. Church.
